summary.text: Ed Charbonneau is a Republican member of the Indiana Senate for District 5, serving since 2007.
The caucus page lists Charbonneau as chair of the Health and Provider Services Committee.

paragraphs.text: Charbonneau attended Wabash College, earned an MBA from Loyola University Chicago and a J.D. from South Texas College of Law, and is an attorney, according to the page.
It lists service in the United States Army Reserves from 1966 to 1972.

The page lists earlier roles as interim president and chief executive officer of The Methodist Hospitals, president and chief executive officer of the Northwest Indiana Forum, and head of government and community affairs at U.S. Steel.
Charbonneau represents Pulaski and White counties and portions of Jasper and Porter counties.
